newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romania barley crop to rise to 1.36 mln T-ministry.
newsitem.headline: Romania barley crop to rise to 1.36 mln T-ministry.

text.p: Romania has begun harvesting its 1997 barley crop and expects output to rise to 1.36 million tonnes from last year's 890,000, the Agriculture Ministry said on Monday.
In a statement the ministry said around 54,000 ha of barley had been harvested so far, yielding an average of 3,583 kg per hectare, higher than forecasts of 3,278 kg, the statement said.
"These figures were collected on June 26," a ministry source said.
The total area under barley is 419,364 ha.
Barley harvesting is expected to be completed by mid-July, a ministry source said.
Last year, the crop was hit by bad weather.
